blocks.text: can va be able to: qobiliyat va imkoniyat

**can** — «-a olaman», «...sa bo'ladi», **could** — uning o'tmishdagi shakli (→ qizil kitob, 30-dars). Muammo shundaki, can — modal fe'l: uning faqat ikki shakli bor (can, could), infinitivi ham, -ing shakli ham yo'q, will yoki have dan keyin kelmaydi. O'zbekchadagi «-a olmoq» esa hamma zamonda ishlaydi: o'qiy olaman, o'qiy oldim, o'qiy oladigan bo'laman. Inglizchada bu «bo'shliqlarni» **be able to** to'ldiradi — u istalgan zamonda va istalgan modal fe'ldan keyin keladi.

rows: Next year I**'ll be able to** vote.
I'd like **to be able to** cook.
I love **being able to** work from home.
I **used to be able to** run fast.

items.text: I hope I**'ll be able to** visit you in Oxford next summer.
items.translation: Kelasi yozda Oksfordga oldingizga **bora olaman** deb umid qilaman.

items.text: Kate **hasn't been able to** find a flat near her work.
It's nice **to be able to** speak to customers in their own language.
items.translation: Mijozlar bilan o'z tilida **gaplasha olish** yoqimli.

blocks.text: Kelajak: can yoki will be able to?

Kelajak haqida gapirganda farq bor. Agar imkoniyat **hozir** mavjud bo'lsa yoki hozir kelishilayotgan bo'lsa — **can**: I **can** meet you tomorrow — Ertaga siz bilan uchrasha olaman (ertaga bo'shman). Agar qobiliyat yoki imkoniyat **hali yo'q** va keyin paydo bo'ladigan bo'lsa — **will be able to**: After the course you**'ll be able to** drive — Kursdan keyin mashina hayday oladigan bo'lasiz. «will can» degan shakl umuman yo'q. Hozirgi zamonda **am / is / are able to** ham to'g'ri, lekin u rasmiyroq; kundalik nutqda **can** tabiiyroq.

items.text: I **can** help you with the move on Saturday — I'm free all day.
items.translation: Shanba kuni ko'chishga **yordam bera olaman** — kun bo'yi bo'shman.

items.text: In a year Madina **will be able to** read Korean novels.
items.translation: Bir yildan keyin Madina koreys romanlarini **o'qiy oladigan bo'ladi**.

items.text: Sorry, I **can't** come to dinner tomorrow — I'm working late.
items.translation: Kechirasiz, ertaga kechki ovqatga **kela olmayman** — kechgacha ishlayman.

blocks.text: **could** — o'tmishda **umuman, doim** qila olgan narsamiz: When I was young, I **could** run ten kilometres — Yoshligimda o'n kilometr yugura olardim. O'zbekchadagi «-a olardim» ga juda mos. Bundan tashqari, **see, hear, smell, taste, feel, understand, remember** fe'llari bilan could **bitta muayyan holat** uchun ham tabiiy: I **could hear** music from next door — Qo'shni xonadan musiqa eshitilib turardi.
was able to / managed to — bitta holatda uddalash

O'tmishdagi **bitta muayyan** holatda biror narsani (ko'pincha qiyinchilik bilan) **uddalaganimizni** aytganda darak gapda could ishlatilmaydi — **was / were able to** yoki **managed to** kerak: The fire spread fast, but everyone **was able to** escape. O'zbekchada bu «-a oldim», «uddaladim». Inkor gapda esa ikkalasi ham to'g'ri: I **couldn't** / **wasn't able to** find the hotel. Ya'ni taqiq faqat bitta holatdagi **darak** gap uchun.

rows: ✓ He **was able to** swim to the shore.
✓ He **wasn't able to** swim to the shore.
Sezgi va idrok fe'llari (see, hear, understand...)

items.text: My uncle **could fix** any car engine.
items.translation: Amakim har qanday mashina dvigatelini **tuzata olardi**.

items.text: The engine broke down, but my uncle **was able to** fix it in an hour.
items.translation: Dvigatel buzildi, lekin amakim uni bir soatda **tuzata oldi**.

items.text: We **couldn't open** the window — it was stuck.
I **could hear** someone singing in the street.

blocks.text: **managed to** — «qiyin bo'lsa ham, uddaladi» ma'nosini kuchaytiradi: After three attempts, she **managed to** pass. Qiyinchilik bo'lmagan oddiy holatda shunchaki Past Simple yetarli: «Kecha kinoga bora oldim» → I **went** to the cinema yesterday.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I will can come» → I**'ll be able to** come; «I can to swim» → I **can swim** (can dan keyin to yo'q); «I didn't can» → I **couldn't**; «I have could» → I**'ve been able to**; bitta muvaffaqiyat haqida «I could pass the exam yesterday» → I **was able to** / **managed to** pass; «I know swimming» → I **can** swim.

O'zbekcha qo'shimcha sizga yo'l ko'rsatadi: «-a olardim» (umuman, doim) → **could**; «-a oldim» (bir marta, uddaladim) → **was able to / managed to**; «-a olmadim» → **couldn't** (ikkalasida ham). «-a oladigan bo'laman» → **will be able to**.

examples.title: Now: **can** / **can't**
examples.description: Hozirgi qobiliyat va imkoniyat: «-a olaman», «...sa bo'ladi», «qurbim yetmaydi». Qisqa eslatma — B1 darajadagi vaziyatlarda.

sentences.text: Nilufar **can speak** four languages, including Korean and German.
sentences.translation: Nilufar to'rt tilda, jumladan koreys va nemis tillarida **gapira oladi**.

sentences.text: You **can get** from Tashkent to Samarkand in two hours on the fast train.
sentences.translation: Tezyurar poyezdda Toshkentdan Samarqandga ikki soatda **yetib borish mumkin**.

sentences.text: I'm afraid we **can't afford** a holiday abroad this year.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, bu yil chet elda dam olishga **qurbimiz yetmaydi**.

sentences.text: **Can** you **read** this signature? I have no idea whose it is.
sentences.translation: Bu imzoni **o'qiy olasanmi**? Kimniki ekanini umuman bilmayman.

sentences.text: Without his glasses, Grandpa **can't see** the numbers on his phone.
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynaksiz bobom telefonidagi raqamlarni **ko'ra olmaydi**.

sentences.text: Our new printer **can scan** documents and send them straight to your email.
sentences.translation: Yangi printerimiz hujjatlarni skanerlab, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri pochtangizga **yubora oladi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **can't come** to the meeting — I'm stuck in traffic.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, yig'ilishga **kela olmayman** — tirbandlikda qolib ketdim.

sentences.text: Anyone **can learn** to cook plov — you just need patience and good rice.
sentences.translation: Palov pishirishni har kim **o'rgana oladi** — faqat sabr va yaxshi guruch kerak.

sentences.text: This lift **can carry** up to eight people at a time.
sentences.translation: Bu lift bir vaqtda sakkiz kishigacha **ko'tara oladi**.

sentences.text: James **can't stand** loud music, so he never goes to clubs.
sentences.translation: Jeyms baland musiqaga **toqat qila olmaydi**, shuning uchun hech qachon klubga bormaydi.

examples.title: Future: **will be able to**
examples.description: Hali yo'q, keyin paydo bo'ladigan qobiliyat yoki imkoniyat — will be able to («will can» yo'q).

sentences.text: After this course you**'ll be able to** write a professional CV in English.
sentences.translation: Bu kursdan keyin ingliz tilida professional rezyume **yoza oladigan bo'lasiz**.

sentences.text: When the new terminal opens, the airport **will be able to** handle twice as many flights.
sentences.translation: Yangi terminal ochilgach, aeroport ikki baravar ko'p reysni **qabul qila oladi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod has broken his leg, so he **won't be able to** play in the final.
sentences.translation: Bekzod oyog'ini sindirib oldi, shuning uchun finalda **o'ynay olmaydi**.

sentences.text: **Will** you **be able to** finish the translation by Monday?
sentences.translation: Tarjimani dushanbagacha **tugata olasizmi**?

sentences.text: I hope that one day I**'ll be able to** buy a house with a garden.
sentences.translation: Bir kun bog'li uy **sotib ola olishimga** umid qilaman.

sentences.text: Once Madina gets her licence, she**'ll be able to** drive the children to school.
sentences.translation: Madina guvohnoma olgach, bolalarni maktabga mashinada **olib bora oladi**.

sentences.text: If you save a little every month, you**'ll be able to** afford a new laptop by summer.
sentences.translation: Har oy ozgina pul yig'sang, yozgacha yangi noutbuk olishga **qurbing yetadi**.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the doctor **won't be able to** see you until Thursday.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, shifokor sizni payshanbagacha **qabul qila olmaydi**.

sentences.text: Thanks to the new app, passengers **will be able to** buy metro tickets on their phones.
sentences.translation: Yangi ilova tufayli yo'lovchilar metro chiptalarini telefonda **sotib ola oladi**.

sentences.text: In a few months the baby **will be able to** sit up without help.
sentences.translation: Bir necha oydan keyin chaqaloq yordamsiz **o'tira oladi**.

examples.title: Other forms: **have been able to**, **to be able to**
examples.description: can bo'lmagan joylarda — Present Perfect, infinitiv, -ing shakli, modal fe'ldan keyin, used to dan keyin — be able to.

sentences.text: I**'ve been able to** relax much more since I started working from home.
sentences.translation: Uydan ishlashni boshlaganimdan beri ancha **dam ola oladigan bo'ldim**.

sentences.text: Emma **hasn't been able to** sleep properly since the baby was born.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq tug'ilgandan beri Emma yaxshi **uxlay olmayapti**.

sentences.text: It's wonderful **to be able to** walk to work in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Ishga o'n daqiqada piyoda **bora olish** ajoyib.

sentences.text: Sarah would love **to be able to** play the guitar like her brother.
sentences.translation: Sara akasidek gitara **chala olishni** juda xohlardi.

sentences.text: **Being able to** speak Russian really helped Tom when he worked in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Rus tilida **gapira olishi** Tomga Toshkentda ishlaganida juda yordam berdi.

sentences.text: You **might be able to** find a cheaper ticket if you book online.
sentences.translation: Onlayn band qilsangiz, arzonroq chipta **topa olishingiz mumkin**.

sentences.text: Jasur **used to be able to** run ten kilometres, but now he gets tired after two.
sentences.translation: Jasur avval o'n kilometr **yugura olardi**, endi esa ikki kilometrdan keyin charchaydi.

sentences.text: The company **hasn't been able to** find a new accountant for three months.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya uch oydan beri yangi buxgalter **topa olmayapti**.

sentences.text: Applicants **must be able to** work in a team and speak basic English.
sentences.translation: Nomzodlar jamoada **ishlay olishi** va oddiy ingliz tilida gapira olishi **shart**.

sentences.text: I'm sorry for not **being able to** come to your wedding last month.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy to'yingizga **kela olmaganim** uchun uzr so'rayman.

examples.title: Past ability in general: **could**
examples.description: O'tmishda umuman, doim qila olgan narsa — could, o'zbekcha «-a olardim». Inkori — couldn't.

sentences.text: When I was five, I **could** already **read** and write a little.
sentences.translation: Besh yoshimda allaqachon biroz **o'qiy** va yoza **olardim**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **could sew** beautiful dresses without a pattern.
sentences.translation: Buvim andozasiz chiroyli ko'ylaklar **tika olardi**.

sentences.text: Before the accident, Oliver **could play** the piano really well.
sentences.translation: Avariyadan oldin Oliver pianinoni juda yaxshi **chala olardi**.

sentences.text: We **couldn't afford** a car when the children were small.
sentences.translation: Bolalar kichikligida mashina olishga **qurbimiz yetmasdi**.

sentences.text: As a teenager, Kate **could swim** across the lake and back without stopping.
sentences.translation: O'smirligida Keyt ko'lning narigi qirg'og'iga suzib borib, to'xtamasdan **qaytib kela olardi**.

sentences.text: In the old days you **couldn't buy** anything online, so we queued for hours.
sentences.translation: Ilgari internetdan hech narsa **sotib olib bo'lmasdi**, shuning uchun soatlab navbatda turardik.

sentences.text: Aziz **could** never **understand** why his brother left such a good job.
sentences.translation: Aziz akasi nega shunday yaxshi ishni tashlab ketganini hech qachon **tushuna olmasdi**.

sentences.text: **Could** you **speak** English before you moved to London? — Only a little.
sentences.translation: Londonga ko'chishdan oldin ingliz tilida **gapira olarmidingiz**? — Ozgina.

sentences.text: From our old flat we **could see** the mountains on a clear day.
sentences.translation: Eski kvartiramizdan ochiq kunlarda tog'lar **ko'rinib turardi**.

sentences.text: At university Dilnoza **could** easily **study** all night and still feel fresh in the morning.
sentences.translation: Universitetda Dilnoza bemalol tun bo'yi **o'qiy olardi** va ertalab baribir tetik bo'lardi.

examples.title: One occasion: **was able to** / **managed to**
examples.description: O'tmishdagi bitta muayyan holatda uddalash — darak gapda could emas, was able to yoki managed to. O'zbekcha «-a oldim».

sentences.text: The fire spread quickly, but all the guests **were able to** get out of the hotel.
sentences.translation: Yong'in tez tarqaldi, lekin barcha mehmonlar mehmonxonadan **chiqib keta olishdi**.

sentences.text: The road was closed, but we **managed to** find another way to the airport.
sentences.translation: Yo'l yopiq edi, lekin aeroportga boshqa yo'l **topa oldik**.

sentences.text: After hours of searching, Madina **was able to** find her lost passport.
sentences.translation: Soatlab qidirgandan keyin Madina yo'qolgan pasportini **topa oldi**.

sentences.text: In the last minute Uzbekistan **managed to** score the winning goal.
sentences.translation: So'nggi daqiqada O'zbekiston g'alaba golini **ura oldi**.

sentences.text: Although the exam was hard, Jasur **was able to** answer every question.
sentences.translation: Imtihon qiyin bo'lsa ham, Jasur har bir savolga **javob bera oldi**.

sentences.text: I **managed to** get the last two tickets for the concert!
sentences.translation: Konsertning oxirgi ikkita chiptasini **olishga ulgurdim**!

sentences.text: Did you **manage to** talk to the director before he left?
sentences.translation: Direktor ketishidan oldin u bilan **gaplasha oldingizmi**?

sentences.text: After a six-hour operation, the surgeons **were able to** save the climber's leg.
sentences.translation: Olti soatlik operatsiyadan keyin jarrohlar alpinistning oyog'ini **saqlab qola olishdi**.

sentences.text: Somehow the old car **managed to** climb the steep mountain road.
sentences.translation: Qandaydir yo'l bilan eski mashina tik tog' yo'lidan **chiqib ola oldi**.

sentences.text: We were lost in Edinburgh, but a kind stranger **was able to** show us the way.
sentences.translation: Edinburgda adashib qoldik, lekin bir mehribon notanish odam bizga yo'lni **ko'rsata oldi**.

examples.title: **could**, **was able to** or **couldn't**?
examples.description: Taqqoslash: umumiy qobiliyat (could), bitta muvaffaqiyat (was able to / managed to), inkor (couldn't) va sezgi fe'llari bilan could.

sentences.text: Tom **could** ski very well when he was younger.
sentences.translation: Tom yoshligida chang'ida juda yaxshi **ucha olardi**.

sentences.text: Yesterday Tom **was able to** ski down the black run for the first time.
sentences.translation: Kecha Tom birinchi marta qora trassadan **tusha oldi**.

sentences.text: I looked everywhere, but I **couldn't find** my keys.
sentences.translation: Hamma yoqni qidirdim, lekin kalitlarimni **topa olmadim**.

sentences.text: The phone line was bad, so we **weren't able to** hear each other properly.
sentences.translation: Telefon aloqasi yomon edi, shuning uchun bir-birimizni yaxshi **eshita olmadik**.

sentences.text: From the balcony we **could hear** the sea all night.
sentences.translation: Balkondan tun bo'yi dengiz shovqini **eshitilib turdi**.

sentences.text: Suddenly I **could smell** smoke, so I ran to the kitchen.
sentences.translation: To'satdan tutun **hidini sezdim** va oshxonaga yugurdim.

sentences.text: Nilufar **could remember** every word of the poem, even years later.
sentences.translation: Nilufar she'rning har bir so'zini yillar o'tib ham **eslay olardi**.

sentences.text: Kate was nervous, but she **managed to** give the speech without any mistakes.
sentences.translation: Keyt hayajonlangan edi, lekin nutqni xatosiz **so'zlay oldi**.

sentences.text: **Could** you **understand** what the guide was saying? His accent was so strong.
sentences.translation: Gid nima deyayotganini **tushuna oldingizmi**? Aksenti juda kuchli edi.

sentences.text: The bank was closed, but luckily I **was able to** withdraw money from a cash machine.
sentences.translation: Bank yopiq edi, lekin baxtimga bankomatdan pul **yecha oldim**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a difficult journey home
examples.description: Ikki hamkasb kechagi qiyin yo'l haqida gaplashadi: could, was able to, managed to, will be able to, have been able to.

sentences.text: — Hi Emma! **Were** you **able to** get home last night?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Emma! Kecha uyga **yetib bora oldingmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, but only at two in the morning. I **couldn't get** a taxi anywhere.
sentences.translation: — Ha, lekin faqat tungi soat ikkida. Hech qayerdan taksi **topa olmadim**.

sentences.text: — Oh no! So how **did** you **manage to** get back?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Unda qanday qilib **qaytib kela olding**?

sentences.text: — A colleague **was able to** give me a lift halfway.
sentences.translation: — Bir hamkasbim meni yarim yo'lgacha **olib keta oldi**.

sentences.text: — Lucky you. **Could** you **sleep** at all after that?
sentences.translation: — Omading bor ekan. Undan keyin umuman **uxlay oldingmi**?

sentences.text: — Not really. I **can** never **sleep** after a stressful evening.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas. Asabiy kechdan keyin hech qachon **uxlay olmayman**.

sentences.text: — **Will** you **be able to** work today, or are you taking a day off?
sentences.translation: — Bugun **ishlay olasanmi** yoki dam olasanmi?

sentences.text: — I'll try, but I **haven't been able to** concentrate all morning.
sentences.translation: — Harakat qilaman, lekin ertalabdan beri diqqatimni **jamlay olmayapman**.

sentences.text: — Go home early. You **won't be able to** do good work like this.
sentences.translation: — Uyga ertaroq ket. Bu holatda yaxshi **ishlay olmaysan**.

sentences.text: — You're right. Hopefully I**'ll be able to** catch up tomorrow.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri aytasan. Umid qilamanki, ertaga qolgan ishlarni **bitira olaman**.

examples.title: Mixed: work, health and technology
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: can, could, be able to va managed to ning barcha shakllari murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: Since the operation, my father **has been able to** walk without a stick.
sentences.translation: Operatsiyadan beri otam hassasiz **yura oladigan bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Robots **can** now **perform** some operations more accurately than human surgeons.
sentences.translation: Endi robotlar ba'zi operatsiyalarni jarrohlardan aniqroq **bajara oladi**.

sentences.text: Despite the storm, the pilot **managed to** land the plane safely in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bo'ronga qaramay, uchuvchi samolyotni Buxoroga xavfsiz **qo'ndira oldi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **could** explain why the system crashed every Monday morning.
sentences.translation: Tizim nega har dushanba ertalab ishdan chiqishini hech kim **tushuntira olmadi**.

sentences.text: With the new software, staff **will be able to** work from anywhere in the world.
sentences.translation: Yangi dastur bilan xodimlar dunyoning istalgan joyidan **ishlay oladi**.

sentences.text: I'm sorry I **couldn't help** you yesterday — I was in meetings all day.
sentences.translation: Kecha sizga **yordam bera olmaganim** uchun uzr — kun bo'yi yig'ilishlarda edim.

sentences.text: **Being able to** work flexible hours is important for parents with young children.
sentences.translation: Kichik bolali ota-onalar uchun moslashuvchan grafikda **ishlay olish** muhim.

sentences.text: Doctors **haven't been able to** find a cure for the common cold yet.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar hali oddiy shamollashga davo **topa olishmadi**.

sentences.text: As a child, James **could** draw anything he saw, so everyone expected him to become an artist.
sentences.translation: Bolaligida Jeyms ko'rgan har narsasini **chiza olardi**, shuning uchun hamma uni rassom bo'ladi deb kutardi.

sentences.text: Thanks to video calls, Nilufar **can see** her grandchildren in London every day.
sentences.translation: Video qo'ng'iroqlar tufayli Nilufar Londondagi nevaralarini har kuni **ko'ra oladi**.
